picture.label: Q01 the rite
picture.purpose: The nave, the Hierophant, the couple and the bell, the answer from the gallery.

picture.label: Unread
picture.purpose: The aide brings the warrant; her hand goes out; her eyes stay on the tower.

picture.label: The seal
picture.purpose: The ring into the wax; the seal left on the page.

picture.label: The warrant lifted
picture.purpose: The cause: the sealed warrant raised, and the tilt up the tower to the bell in its chains. Cropped so the stray panel beside the bell is out of frame.

picture.label: The barge lets go
picture.purpose: The effect, wide: the bell drops, the chains fall away.

picture.label: The hammer
picture.purpose: Drawn back, the swing, the stroke, a hold. Cropped so the ringers are out of frame; the ropes run off the left.

picture.label: The still cup
picture.purpose: The first cup, as the author prefers; slowed to half speed so it can be read (Orison moves slowly).
